# cortex_catalog (Data Source)

Catalog data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cortex_catalog" "example" {
  slug = "my-services"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Unique identifier (slug) for the catalog.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the catalog.
- `filter` (Attributes) Filter configuration for the catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `icon_tag` (String) Icon tag for the catalog.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_cortex_managed` (Boolean) Whether this catalog is managed by Cortex.
- `is_draft` (Boolean) Whether the catalog is a draft.
- `name` (String) Name of the catalog.
- `relationship_type_tag` (String) Tag of the relationship type associated with this catalog.
- `type` (String) Type of the catalog. One of: FILTER, RELATIONSHIP_TYPE, DOMAIN.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Read-Only:

- `groups` (Attributes) Group filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--groups))
- `query` (String) Query string for the filter.
- `types` (Attributes) Entity type filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--types))

<a id="nestedatt--filter--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.groups`

Read-Only:

- `exclude` (List of String) List of groups to exclude.
- `include` (List of String) List of groups to include.


<a id="nestedatt--filter--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.types`

Read-Only:

- `exclude` (List of String) List of entity types to exclude.
- `include` (List of String) List of entity types to include.
